si_4_title.answer: Normative modeling of brain morphometry in self-limited epilepsy with centrotemporal spikes

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: devCCNP (CKG and PEK samples) used for normative modeling; SINGLE-SITE (Jinling Hospital) used for clinical application.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "To ensure the generalizability of the normative models, we included additional normal data to train the models. The data for model training consists of two samples: the CKG sample and the PEK sample. Samples from the two different centers are both sourced from the developing Chinese Color Nest Project (devCCNP)." ... "The case-control cohort comprised 187 children with SeLECTS... Additionally, the study included 108 controls... received approval from the medical ethics committee of Jinling Hospital"
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.location: study_1/Yang2025.pdf.md: Materials and methods / Participants, Paragraph 1-2

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: devCCNP provided 457 healthy individuals for model training. The SINGLE-SITE dataset (Jinling Hospital) provided 187 patients and 108 controls for mapping deviations and clinical analysis.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "normative models for each regional morphometric measure were developed utilizing data from a multisite sample of 457 healthy individuals... from the devCCNP." ... "These models were then utilized to map the brain morphometric deviations of children with Self-limited epilepsy with centrotemporal spikes ( n = 187) and sex- and age-matched healthy controls ( n = 108) from another dataset."
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.location: study_1/Yang2025.pdf.md: Materials and methods / Normative modeling & Computing normative deviation..., Paragraph 1

morphometric model.model-name: morphometric model (subcortical volume, cortical thickness, surface area)
